# API

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-api.mjs from https://edenfamily.xyz/api/openapi.json (Eden public API 1.0.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Eden is a token launchpad on Elysium (chain 99901, native HYPE). Tokens trade on a bonding curve, then graduate to a Uniswap v4 pool. One API for the website, bots and agents: no keys. Amounts are decimal strings in wei (18 decimals); errors are { error, message }. Built transactions are verifiable: `to` is a published deployment address (or the token's curve/token), calldata decodes with the published ABIs (/abi on the website), it ends with Eden's marker 4544454e0001, and minOut equals the quote's minOut.

Base URL: `https://edenfamily.xyz/api`. No API keys. The machine-readable spec is [`/api/openapi.json`](https://edenfamily.xyz/api/openapi.json).

## Trading through the API

1. **Quote.** `GET /tokens/{address}/quote?side=buy&amount=<wei>&slippageBps=300` returns `expectedOut` and `minOut`.
2. **Build.** `POST /tx/swap` with `{ token, side, amount, user, slippageBps }` returns the unsigned transactions to sign in order. A sell that needs an allowance gets its approval transactions first.
3. **Verify every transaction before signing:**
   - `chainId` is `99901`;
   - `to` is a published Eden or Uniswap address from [contracts](contracts.md), or the token or its curve;
   - the calldata decodes with the [ABIs](../abi/) (the Universal Router's `execute` for pool trades, see [trade](trade.md)) and ends with Eden's marker `4544454e0001`;
   - the minimum out in the calldata equals the quote's `minOut`, and the amount in is the amount you asked for.
4. **Sign locally.** Your key never leaves your machine; the API never asks for it.
5. **Send.** Broadcast the signed transaction yourself, or `POST /tx/send` with `{ signedTransaction }`. Read the receipt; a reverted trade costs only gas.

`/tx/send` only relays Eden contract calls of the kind the API builds. `POST /tx/launch` and `POST /tx/claim` follow the same build → verify → sign → send flow.

## Tokens

### GET /tokens

**List tokens (Explore).** 

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tab` | query |  | Preset filter and default sort One of `trending`, `new`, `graduating`, `graduated`. Default `trending`. |
| `q` | query |  | Search name, symbol or address |
| `sort` | query |  | Sort column One of `age`, `market_cap`, `change_24h`, `volume_24h`, `volume_1h`, `holders`, `trades`, `progress`, `graduated_at`. |
| `dir` | query |  | Sort direction One of `asc`, `desc`. |
| `pair` | query |  | Only this pair token |
| `min_mcap_usd` | query |  | Market cap at least (USD) |
| `max_mcap_usd` | query |  | Market cap at most (USD) |
| `max_age_hours` | query |  | Launched within |
| `minVolume24h` | query |  | 24 h volume at least, HYPE wei |
| `minHolders` | query |  | At least this many holders |
| `verifiedOnly` | query |  | Only creator_verified tokens |
| `creator` | query |  | Launched by this wallet |
| `graduatedWithinHours` | query |  | Graduated to the pool within the last N hours |
| `limit` | query |  | Page size Default `50`. |
| `offset` | query |  | Offset Default `0`. |

## Quotes & transactions

### GET /tokens/{address}/quote

**Exact quote for a buy or sell.** Curve: EdenBondingCurve's own integer math on its live state (latest block), so a trade in that block gets exactly expectedOut. Pool: the Universal Router's own result by eth_call (V4TooLittleReceived), net of the Eden hook's fee and creator tax.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | path | yes | Token address |
| `side` | query | yes | buy: amount is HYPE in; sell: amount is tokens in One of `buy`, `sell`. |
| `amount` | query | yes | Amount in, wei |
| `slippageBps` | query |  | Slippage for minOut Default `300`. |
| `user` | query |  | The buyer, for the launch-window snipe tax (exempt wallets pay none) |

```bash
curl "https://edenfamily.xyz/api/tokens/$TOKEN/quote?side=buy&amount=1000000000000000000"
```

<details><summary>Example response</summary>

### POST /tx/swap

**Build a buy or sell.** Returns unsigned transactions to sign in order. Curve: the curve's buy/sell (sells approve the curve first when needed). Pool: Universal Router execute(V4_SWAP: SWAP_EXACT_IN_SINGLE, SETTLE_ALL, TAKE_ALL), sells preceded by ERC-20 approve(Permit2) and Permit2.approve(token, router, max, 1 year) as plain transactions only when the on-chain allowance is short. Deadline: max(latest block time, server time) + 600 s. Every tx ends with Eden's marker; the server decodes each one again (to, ABI, amounts, minOut = quote.minOut) and eth_calls it from `user` before answering (steps after an approval are not simulated, see their description).

| Body field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `token` | yes | Token |
| `side` | yes | buy \| sell |
| `amount` | yes | HYPE in (buy) or tokens in (sell) (decimal string, wei) |
| `user` | yes | Signer |
| `slippageBps` |  | 0…5000, default 300 |
| `recipient` |  | Curve only: who receives (default user) |
| `referrer` |  | Referrer address or code: answered with the message to sign if the user is not bound yet |
| `minOut` |  | Use this minimum instead of quote × slippage (e.g. from an earlier quote) (decimal string, wei) |

```bash
curl -X POST "https://edenfamily.xyz/api/tx/swap" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"token":"0x5660162657b586c9a488eCfFf72Efb71F7b495A7","side":"buy","amount":"1000000000000000000","user":"0x8ba1f109551bD432803012645Ac136ddd64DBA72","slippageBps":300}'
```

### POST /tx/launch

**Build a launch (logo made and pinned for you).** image: an https URL or a data: URI (PNG, JPEG or GIF, at most 8 MB). It is cropped to a centred square, drawn at 1024×1024 PNG and pinned to IPFS, exactly as website uploads and X launches. URLs are fetched SSRF-safe: https only, public addresses only (checked at connect time), 3 redirects, 15 s. Launch limits (2 per UTC day, 10 per UTC month per creator) are enforced first. initialBuy > 0 uses LaunchAndBuy (launch + first buy in one transaction; minimum tokens from an exact simulation × slippage).

| Body field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | yes | Creator (signer) |
| `name` | yes | 1…32 characters |
| `symbol` | yes | 1…10 letters/digits (upper-cased) |
| `description` |  | ≤ 256 characters |
| `image` | yes | https:// URL or data:image/…;base64,… |
| `socials` |  | object |
| `initialBuy` |  | HYPE to buy at launch (decimal string, wei) |
| `creatorFeeRecipient` |  | Default: user |
| `creatorTaxBps` |  | 0, 100, 200, 300, 500 or 1000; default 100 |
| `buybackEnabled` |  | Default true |
| `slippageBps` |  | For the initial buy; default 300 |
| `snipeTaxExemptions` |  | array |

```bash
curl -X POST "https://edenfamily.xyz/api/tx/launch" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user":"0x8ba1f109551bD432803012645Ac136ddd64DBA72","name":"Frog","symbol":"FROG","description":"A frog.","image":"https://example.com/frog.png","socials":{"x":"https://x.com/frog"},"initialBuy":"1000000000000000000"}'
```

### POST /tx/claim

**Build fee claims.** Lists what `user` can claim and the transactions to claim it: the fee escrow balance (claim()), creator fees still pending in the user's curves (sweepFees) and pools (sweepPoolFees, when no operator conversion is needed), then claim(). Referral earnings are paid out automatically and are listed for information.

| Body field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | yes | Wallet |
| `token` |  | Only this token |

```bash
curl -X POST "https://edenfamily.xyz/api/tx/claim" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user":"0x8ba1f109551bD432803012645Ac136ddd64DBA72"}'
```

<details><summary>Example response</summary>

```json
{
  "chainId": 99901,
  "claimable": [
    {
      "kind": "fee_escrow",
      "asset": "HYPE",
      "amount": "20000000000000000",
      "how": "claim",
      "note": "Creator fees already credited to you in Eden's fee escrow."
    }
  ],
  "steps": [
    {
      "kind": "claim",
      "description": "Claim your whole HYPE balance from Eden's fee escrow to your wallet.",
      "simulated": true,
      "tx": {
        "to": "0xc66b848a79676b39c0e51f3d6e43596beab868e9",
        "data": "0xd6febde8…4544454e0001",
        "value": "0",
        "chainId": 99901,
        "from": "0x8ba1f109551bD432803012645Ac136ddd64DBA72"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

</details>

### POST /tx/send

**Relay a signed transaction.** Accepts only an Elysium (chainId 99901) transaction to an Eden contract (factory, LaunchAndBuy, a token's curve, Universal Router, Permit2, an Eden token's approve, fee escrow, Eden's hook) calling a function the API builds; then broadcasts it.

| Body field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `signedTransaction` | yes | 0x… signed, serialized transaction |

```bash
curl -X POST "https://edenfamily.xyz/api/tx/send" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"signedTransaction":"0x02f8…"}'
```

<details><summary>Example response</summary>

```json
{
  "hash": "0x9f…",
  "from": "0x8ba1f109551bD432803012645Ac136ddd64DBA72",
  "to": "0x2B1C3E1D9b3F3e0e4A5D6C7b8A9F0e1D2c3b4a59"
}
```

</details>

## Live feed

### GET /ws

**Live updates (WebSocket).** Upgrade to a WebSocket. Send {"subscribe": "<channel>"} or {"unsubscribe": "<channel>"}; channels: feed (every trade, launch, graduation), token:<address> (its trades and token row), wallet:<address> (its trades and referral earnings). Frames: {"channel", "type", "data"} with type trade | launch | graduation | token | referral_earning. Up to 50 channels per socket; frames larger than 4 KB from clients are refused.

```bash
wscat -c wss://edenfamily.xyz/ws
```
